versos.hebraico: חֲזוֹן֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־אָמ֔וֹץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה עַל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֧הוּ יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
controles.kjv: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
controles.livre: Visão de Isaías, filho de Amoz, a qual ele viu sobre Judá e Jerusalém, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz e Ezequias, reis de Judá.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְהַאֲזִ֣ינִי אֶ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּ֑ר בָּנִים֙ גִּדַּ֣לְתִּי וְרוֹמַ֔מְתִּי וְהֵ֖ם פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃

controles.web: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
controles.kjv: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the Lord hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
controles.livre: Ouvi, ó céus; e escutai tu, terra, porque o SENHOR está falando: Eu criei filhos, e os fiz crescerem; porém eles se rebelaram contra mim.

versos.hebraico: יָדַ֥ע שׁוֹר֙ קֹנֵ֔הוּ וַחֲמ֖וֹר אֵב֣וּס בְּעָלָ֑יו יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע עַמִּ֖י לֹ֥א הִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃

controles.web: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know, my people don’t consider.”
controles.kjv: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
controles.livre: O boi conhece a seu dono, e o jumento sabe a manjedoura de seu possuidor; mas Israel não conhece, meu povo não entende.

versos.hebraico: ה֣וֹי׀ גּ֣וֹי חֹטֵ֗א עַ֚ם כֶּ֣בֶד עָוֺ֔ן זֶ֣רַע מְרֵעִ֔ים בָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֑ים עָזְב֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה נִֽאֲצ֛וּ אֶת־קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נָזֹ֥רוּ אָחֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.
controles.kjv: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
controles.livre: Ai da nação pecadora, do povo cheio de perversidade, semente de malfeitores, de filhos corruptos! Abandonaram ao SENHOR, provocaram a ira ao Santo de Israel, dele se afastaram.

versos.hebraico: עַ֣ל מֶ֥ה תֻכּ֛וּ ע֖וֹד תּוֹסִ֣יפוּ סָרָ֑ה כָּל־רֹ֣אשׁ לָחֳלִ֔י וְכָל־לֵבָ֖ב דַּוָּֽי׃

controles.web: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
controles.kjv: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
controles.livre: Para que seríeis espancados ainda mais? Vós vos rebelaríeis mais ainda. Toda a cabeça está enferma, e todo o coração fraco.

versos.hebraico: מִכַּף־רֶ֤גֶל וְעַד־רֹאשׁ֙ אֵֽין־בּ֣וֹ מְתֹ֔ם פֶּ֥צַע וְחַבּוּרָ֖ה וּמַכָּ֣ה טְרִיָּ֑ה לֹא־זֹ֨רוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א חֻבָּ֔שׁוּ וְלֹ֥א רֻכְּכָ֖ה בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, neither bandaged, neither soothed with oil.
controles.kjv: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
controles.livre: Desde a planta do pé até a cabeça, não há nele coisa sã. Só há feridas, inchaços e chagas podres, sem terem sido espremidas, feito curativos ou aliviadas com azeite.

versos.hebraico: אַרְצְכֶ֣ם שְׁמָמָ֔ה עָרֵיכֶ֖ם שְׂרֻפ֣וֹת אֵ֑שׁ אַדְמַתְכֶ֗ם לְנֶגְדְּכֶם֙ זָרִים֙ אֹכְלִ֣ים אֹתָ֔הּ וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֥ת זָרִֽים׃

controles.web: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
controles.kjv: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
controles.livre: Vossa terra é uma ruína; vossas cidades foram queimadas; vossa terra os estranhos devastaram diante de vossa presença, e está arruinada como que destruída por estranhos.

versos.hebraico: וְנוֹתְרָ֥ה בַת־צִיּ֖וֹן כְּסֻכָּ֣ה בְכָ֑רֶם כִּמְלוּנָ֥ה בְמִקְשָׁ֖ה כְּעִ֥יר נְצוּרָֽה׃

controles.web: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.
controles.kjv: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
controles.livre: E a filha de Sião ficou como uma cabana na vinha, como um barraco no pepinal, como uma cidade cercada.

versos.hebraico: לוּלֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הוֹתִ֥יר לָ֛נוּ שָׂרִ֖יד כִּמְעָ֑ט כִּסְדֹ֣ם הָיִ֔ינוּ לַעֲמֹרָ֖ה דָּמִֽינוּ׃ס

controles.web: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom; we would have been like Gomorrah.
controles.kjv: Except the Lord of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
controles.livre: Se o SENHOR dos exércitos não tivesse nos deixado alguns sobreviventes, teríamos sido como Sodoma, seríamos semelhantes aos de Gomorra.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה קְצִינֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם הַאֲזִ֛ינוּ תּוֹרַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַ֥ם עֲמֹרָֽה׃

controles.web: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
controles.kjv: Hear the word of the Lord, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
controles.livre: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, vós líderes de Sodoma! Ouvi a Lei do nosso Deus, vós povo de Gomorra!:

versos.hebraico: לָמָּה־לִּ֤י רֹב־זִבְחֵיכֶם֙ יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׂבַ֛עְתִּי עֹל֥וֹת אֵילִ֖ים וְחֵ֣לֶב מְרִיאִ֑ים וְדַ֨ם פָּרִ֧ים וּכְבָשִׂ֛ים וְעַתּוּדִ֖ים לֹ֥א חָפָֽצְתִּי׃

controles.web: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.
controles.kjv: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the Lord: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
controles.livre: Para que me serve tantos sacrifícios vossos?,diz o SENHOR; Já estou farto de sacrifícios de queima de carneiros, e da gordura de animais cevados. Não me alegro com o sangue de bezerros, nem com o de cordeiros ou bodes.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י תָבֹ֔אוּ לֵרָא֖וֹת פָּנָ֑י מִי־בִקֵּ֥שׁ זֹ֛את מִיֶּדְכֶ֖ם רְמֹ֥ס חֲצֵרָֽי׃

controles.web: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?
controles.kjv: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
controles.livre: Quando vindes a aparecer perante minha face, quem vos pediu isso de vossas mãos, de pisardes em meus pátios?

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א תוֹסִ֗יפוּ הָבִיא֙ מִנְחַת־שָׁ֔וְא קְטֹ֧רֶת תּוֹעֵבָ֛ה הִ֖יא לִ֑י חֹ֤דֶשׁ וְשַׁבָּת֙ קְרֹ֣א מִקְרָ֔א לֹא־אוּכַ֥ל אָ֖וֶן וַעֲצָרָֽה׃

controles.web: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me; new moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can’t bear with evil assemblies.
controles.kjv: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
controles.livre: Não tragais mais ofertas inúteis; vosso incenso para mim é abominação; não aguento mais as luas novas, os sábados, e as chamadas para o povo se reunir; todas estas se tornaram reuniões malignas.

versos.hebraico: חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֤ם וּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֙ שָׂנְאָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י הָי֥וּ עָלַ֖י לָטֹ֑רַח נִלְאֵ֖יתִי נְשֹֽׂא׃

controles.web: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.
controles.kjv: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
controles.livre: Vossas luas novas e vossas solenidades, minha alma as odeia e elas me perturbam; estou cansado de as suportar.

versos.hebraico: וּבְפָרִשְׂכֶ֣ם כַּפֵּיכֶ֗ם אַעְלִ֤ים עֵינַי֙ מִכֶּ֔ם גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־תַרְבּ֥וּ תְפִלָּ֖ה אֵינֶ֣נִּי שֹׁמֵ֑עַ יְדֵיכֶ֖ם דָּמִ֥ים מָלֵֽאוּ׃

controles.web: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.
controles.kjv: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
controles.livre: Por isso quando estendeis vossas mãos, escondo meus olhos de vós; até quando fazeis muitas orações, eu não vos ouço; porque vossas mãos estão cheias de sangue.

versos.hebraico: רַחֲצוּ֙ הִזַּכּ֔וּ הָסִ֛ירוּ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י חִדְל֖וּ הָרֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: Wash yourselves, make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
controles.kjv: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
controles.livre: Lavai-vos! Purificai-vos! Tirai a maldade de vossas atitudes perante meus olhos; parai de fazer maldades.

versos.hebraico: לִמְד֥וּ הֵיטֵ֛ב דִּרְשׁ֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט אַשְּׁר֣וּ חָמ֑וֹץ שִׁפְט֣וּ יָת֔וֹם רִ֖יבוּ אַלְמָנָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Judge the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
controles.kjv: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
controles.livre: Aprendei a fazer o bem; procurai o que é justo; ajudai ao oprimido; fazei justiça ao órfão; defendei a causa da viúva.

versos.hebraico: לְכוּ־נָ֛א וְנִוָּֽכְחָ֖ה יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־יִֽהְי֨וּ חֲטָאֵיכֶ֤ם כַּשָּׁנִים֙ כַּשֶּׁ֣לֶג יַלְבִּ֔ינוּ אִם־יַאְדִּ֥ימוּ כַתּוֹלָ֖ע כַּצֶּ֥מֶר יִהְיֽוּ׃

controles.web: “Come now, and let us reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
controles.kjv: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
controles.livre: Vinde, então, e façamos as contas,diz o SENHOR: ainda que vossos pecados sejam como a escarlate, eles ficarão brancos como a neve; ainda que sejam vermelhos como o carmesim, eles se tornarão como a lã.

versos.hebraico: אִם־תֹּאב֖וּ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם ט֥וּב הָאָ֖רֶץ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;
controles.kjv: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
controles.livre: Se quiserdes e ouvirdes, comereis o que é bom da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־תְּמָאֲנ֖וּ וּמְרִיתֶ֑ם חֶ֣רֶב תְּאֻכְּל֔וּ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

controles.web: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
controles.kjv: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
controles.livre: Porém se recusardes e fordes rebeldes, sereis devorados pela espada;pois foi assim que a boca do SENHOR falou.

versos.hebraico: אֵיכָה֙ הָיְתָ֣ה לְזוֹנָ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָ֑ה מְלֵאֲתִ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֗ט צֶ֛דֶק יָלִ֥ין בָּ֖הּ וְעַתָּ֥ה מְרַצְּחִֽים׃

controles.web: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.
controles.kjv: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
controles.livre: Como a cidade fiel se tornou uma prostituta! Ela estava cheia de juízo, justiça habitava nela; porém agora homicidas.

versos.hebraico: כַּסְפֵּ֖ךְ הָיָ֣ה לְסִיגִ֑ים סָבְאֵ֖ךְ מָה֥וּל בַּמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.
controles.kjv: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
controles.livre: Tua prata se tornou em escórias; teu vinho se misturou com água.

versos.hebraico: שָׂרַ֣יִךְ סוֹרְרִ֗ים וְחַבְרֵי֙ גַּנָּבִ֔ים כֻּלּוֹ֙ אֹהֵ֣ב שֹׁ֔חַד וְרֹדֵ֖ף שַׁלְמֹנִ֑ים יָתוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁפֹּ֔טוּ וְרִ֥יב אַלְמָנָ֖ה לֹֽא־יָב֥וֹא אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes, and follows after rewards. They don’t judge the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.
controles.kjv: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
controles.livre: Teus príncipes são rebeldes, e companheiros de ladrões; cada um deles ama os subornos, e perseguem recompensas; não fazem justiça ao órfão, e não chega perante eles a causa das viúvas.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן נְאֻ֤ם הָֽאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲבִ֖יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֚וֹי אֶנָּחֵ֣ם מִצָּרַ֔י וְאִנָּקְמָ֖ה מֵאוֹיְבָֽי׃

controles.web: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies;
controles.kjv: Therefore saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
controles.livre: Por isso diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos, o Poderoso de Israel: Ah, tomarei satisfações quanto aos meus adversários, e me vingarei de meus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְאֶצְרֹ֥ף כַּבֹּ֖ר סִיגָ֑יִךְ וְאָסִ֖ירָה כָּל־בְּדִילָֽיִךְ׃

controles.web: and I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.
controles.kjv: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
controles.livre: E tornarei minha minha mão contra ti, e purificarei por completo tuas escórias; e tirarei toda a tua impureza.

versos.hebraico: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה שֹׁפְטַ֨יִךְ֙ כְּבָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה וְיֹעֲצַ֖יִךְ כְּבַתְּחִלָּ֑ה אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן יִקָּ֤רֵא לָךְ֙ עִ֣יר הַצֶּ֔דֶק קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃

controles.web: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’
controles.kjv: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
controles.livre: E restituirei a teus juízes, como da primeira vez, e a teus conselheiros, como no princípio; e depois disso te chamarão cidade da justiça, cidade fiel.

versos.hebraico: צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃

controles.web: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.
controles.kjv: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
controles.livre: Sião será resgatada por meio do juízo; e os que retornarem a ela, por meio da justiça.

versos.hebraico: וְשֶׁ֧בֶר פֹּשְׁעִ֛ים וְחַטָּאִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְעֹזְבֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִכְלֽוּ׃

controles.web: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.
controles.kjv: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the Lord shall be consumed.
controles.livre: Mas para os transgressores e pecadores, serão juntamente quebrados; e os que deixarem ao SENHOR serão consumidos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מֵאֵילִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲמַדְתֶּ֑ם וְתַ֨חְפְּר֔וּ מֵהַגַּנּ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃

controles.web: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
controles.kjv: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
controles.livre: Porque pelos carvalhos que cobiçastes serão confundidos; e pelos bosques que escolhestes sereis envergonhados;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י תִֽהְי֔וּ כְּאֵלָ֖ה נֹבֶ֣לֶת עָלֶ֑הָ וּֽכְגַנָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־מַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָֽהּ׃

controles.web: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.
controles.kjv: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
controles.livre: Porque sereis como o carvalho ao qual suas folhas caem, e como o bosque que não tem água.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֤ה הֶחָסֹן֙ לִנְעֹ֔רֶת וּפֹעֲל֖וֹ לְנִיצ֑וֹץ וּבָעֲר֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם יַחְדָּ֖ו וְאֵ֥ין מְכַבֶּֽה׃ס

controles.web: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
controles.kjv: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
controles.livre: E o forte se tornará em estopa, e sua obra, em faísca; e ambos serão juntamente queimados, e não haverá quem os apague.
